plate.prompt:
stylized low-poly game art, in the style of the attached reference. big flat facets,
chunky bevelled shapes, flat colour planes with 2 or 3 values per colour, crisp dark
outlines. matte paint: no gloss, no reflection on any floor, no specular highlight,
no bloom. a few flat paint chips and rust patches, no noise texture. palette: cream,
teal, mustard, olive, rust, small orange lights, navy. warm key light from the upper
left, cool rim. space is near black navy with many small stars, no fog. not
photographic, not realistic, no depth of field.

outpost rigging workshop interior, wide 16:9 plate, 2048 × 1152. orthographic cutaway at 42 degree azimuth and 29 degree elevation. large rectangular raised deck with left and rear walls, front open. left wall recedes from lower left toward upper middle; rear wall runs from upper middle toward right. cream walls, teal beams, mustard overhead gantry inside the hall. tool wall at left; two recessed bays in rear wall. left bay contains power rack with chunky cream and teal reactor modules; right bay contains drive rack with chunky rust and olive drive modules. racks stand inside the bays and share the room perspective. central empty bay for a 70 metre long ship with 19 metre beam: two parallel long low teal cradles run from lower left toward upper right. each cradle has flat mustard support top. cradle length about 70 metres, separation 12 metres, closer than ship beam. clear space above cradles; no ship painted into plate. keep cradles parallel and level at equal heights. simple broad matte grey floor panels, mustard edge lines, calm cream wall panels for cards. a few tied hoses and strapped boxes along edges. doors 3 metres and rails 1.1 metres give scale. no people, planet, interface, text or separate sprites. navy space around the cutaway, many small stars. attached platform is the sole style anchor.

critical cradle geometry: make the two support rails a CLOSE PAIR, not widely separated lanes. each is about six times longer than the perpendicular gap between their centre lines. in the 2048 × 1152 composition, the left support top runs from approximately (660, 650) to (1190, 330), the right support top from (745, 690) to (1275, 370). both rails have the same length and height. a single 19 metre wide ship must rest on both, the supports are 12 metres apart, their length is 70 metres. leave the rest of the deck clear. use only the attached platform as the style anchor.
